Document the US1 independent validation path in `specs/001-vulkan-elmish-viewer/quickstart.md`

Add test fixtures or interpreter seams that can simulate missing Vulkan instance, device, surface, and swapchain capabilities without invoking real GPU resources
Implement fail-fast startup validation for unsupported OS, headless surface absence, Vulkan instance failure, device selection failure, surface failure, swapchain failure, and Skia context failure
Ensure `Viewer.run` returns `Result<unit, RenderDiagnostic>` for startup failures before rendering begins

Add emitted-effect assertions for initialize, render frame, capture screenshot, shutdown, diagnostic reporting, and dispatch effects
Add subscription tests that verify a timer-style subscription dispatches messages without direct mutable scene pushes
